summary: Rename the ChatGPT adapter package and executable to fractal-chatgpt

replay.detail: No graph replay or data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordination rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The canonical Cargo binary and Nix package are fractal-chatgpt. Nix retains the st-chatgpt package alias and executable symlink in the same derivation for existing consumers. Tools, grant authority, and socket acceptance are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or service interruption is required by this package rename.

manual.detail: Source builds should select --bin fractal-chatgpt. Existing Nix consumers may keep using the st-chatgpt package and executable during the rename bridge.

recovery.detail: No persistent data is changed. The retained st-chatgpt executable alias continues to invoke the same adapter.
